name: PublishPlaywrightBddReport
description: Publish a playwright-bdd HTML report (Cucumber or Playwright) so it can be reviewed in the "Playwright BDD" tab of the pipeline run.
helpMarkDown: Packs the report folder and attaches it to the run. Open the run and select the **Playwright BDD** tab to browse it, with no download needed. Add `condition: succeededOrFailed()` so the report is also published when tests fail.
author: Shko Online

inputs.name: reportDir
inputs.label: Report folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder that contains the HTML report, e.g. `cucumber-report` (playwright-bdd `cucumberReporter('html')`) or `playwright-report` (Playwright HTML reporter). Relative paths are resolved against `$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)`.

inputs.name: entryFile
inputs.label: Entry HTML file
inputs.helpMarkDown: HTML file inside the report folder to open first. If it does not exist, the first `.html` file in the folder root is used.

inputs.name: reportName
inputs.label: Report name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name shown in the tab's report picker. Defaults to the job name. Use a distinct name when the same job publishes more than one report.

inputs.name: ifMissing
inputs.label: When the report folder is missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when the report folder or its entry file cannot be found (for example when the test step was skipped).
